sql: SELECT schools.School, schools.DOC FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" - frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (SELECT AVG(f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded')

SELECT schools.AdmFName1, schools.AdmLName1, schools.AdmFName2, schools.AdmLName2, schools.AdmFName3, schools.AdmLName3 FROM satscores JOIN schools ON CAST(satscores.cds AS INTEGER) = CAST(schools.CDSCode AS INTEGER) WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' AND satscores.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores WHERE rtype = 'S')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles' AND schools.Charter = 0 AND (frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18

SELECT schools.City, COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode WHERE schools.Magnet = 1 AND schools.GSoffered = 'K-8' AND frpm."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY schools.City
SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2 FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' AND City = 'San Bernardino' AND DOC = '54' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' AND SOC = '62'

SELECT MAX(frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS max_ratio FROM satscores JOIN frpm ON CAST(satscores.cds AS INTEGER) = CAST(frpm.CDSCode AS INTEGER) WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr > 0.3
SELECT schools.School, schools.Street FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE (frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" - frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30

SELECT frpm."School Name" FROM frpm JOIN satscores ON CAST(frpm.CDSCode AS INTEGER) = CAST(satscores.cds AS INTEGER) WHERE frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1 AND satscores.NumGE1500 > 0

SELECT satscores.sname, frpm."Charter Funding Type" FROM satscores JOIN frpm ON CAST(satscores.cds AS INTEGER) = CAST(frpm.CDSCode AS INTEGER) WHERE satscores.dname LIKE 'Riverside%' AND satscores.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT frpm."School Name", schools.Street, schools.City, schools.State, schools.Zip FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Monterey' AND frpm."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)' AND frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT schools.School, satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.Phone FROM schools JOIN satscores ON CAST(schools.CDSCode AS INTEGER) = CAST(satscores.cds AS INTEGER) WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' AND (schools.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR schools.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01')
SELECT frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS ratio FROM frpm ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores JOIN schools ON CAST(satscores.cds AS INTEGER) = CAST(schools.CDSCode AS INTEGER) WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' AND satscores.AvgScrMath > 400 AND schools.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT schools.CharterNum, satscores.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM schools JOIN satscores ON CAST(schools.CDSCode AS INTEGER) = CAST(satscores.cds AS INTEGER) WHERE satscores.rtype = 'S' AND satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
